title: 云平台对象存储：三副本还是纠删码
title_en: Cloud object storage: replicas or erasure coding
summary: 64 台存储节点、768 块 16 TB 盘：比较三副本、RS(6,3)、RS(10,4) 的可用容量、修复时间、数据持久性和读延迟；马尔可夫链算几个 9，蒙特卡洛（固定修复时间）对照；读延迟仿真看出纠删码小文件尾延迟高、大文件反而快；选热数据三副本 + 温冷数据 RS(6,3)；云平台版本构建 10 次、云订阅开通 24 份验收。
summary_en: 64 storage nodes with 768 × 16 TB disks: 3-way replication, RS(6,3) and RS(10,4) compared on usable capacity, repair time, durability and read latency; Markov-chain durability cross-checked by Monte Carlo with fixed repair times; latency simulation shows erasure coding has a worse tail for small objects but is faster for large ones; hot data on replicas, warm and cold data on RS(6,3); 10 platform builds and 24 cloud subscriptions accepted.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 64 台节点 768 块盘（12.3 PB 裸）：三年 ≥ 4 PB 可用、11 个 9、扛整柜故障、小文件 p99 ≤ 30 ms。
steps.summary_en: 64 nodes, 768 disks (12.3 PB raw): ≥ 4 PB usable in three years, 11 nines, survive a rack failure, small-object p99 ≤ 30 ms.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 三副本只有 3.28 PB 装不下；选热数据三副本 + 温冷 RS(6,3)：可用 5.70 PB，持久性都过 11 个 9，整柜故障不丢。
steps.summary_en: Replication alone gives only 3.28 PB; hot data on replicas plus warm/cold on RS(6,3) gives 5.70 PB, all above 11 nines, rack-failure safe.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 修复：三副本 2.3 h、RS(6,3) 11.2 h；持久性 12.5 / 13.7 个 9；一柜最多 3 块 ≤ 能坏 3 块。
steps.summary_en: Repair: replicas 2.3 h, RS(6,3) 11.2 h; durability 12.5 / 13.7 nines; at most 3 chunks per rack ≤ 3 tolerated.

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 蒙特卡洛（固定修复）与马尔可夫链相差 ≤ 2 %；小文件 p99：三副本 31.2 ms，加对冲读 28.1 ms，RS(6,3) 43.6 ms；大文件 RS(6,3) 更快。
steps.summary_en: Monte Carlo (fixed repair) within 2 % of the Markov chain; small-object p99 31.2 ms replicas, 28.1 ms with hedged reads, vs 43.6 ms RS(6,3); RS(6,3) is faster for large objects.

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 柜 → 节点 → 盘三级故障域；三副本分 3 柜，RS(6,3) 按 3/2/2/2 分 4 柜；热池、温冷池、元数据、网关的架构图。
steps.summary_en: Rack → node → disk failure domains; replicas across 3 racks, RS(6,3) split 3/2/2/2 over 4 racks; architecture with hot and warm/cold pools, metadata and gateways.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 版本 7 道（集成测试加拔盘、断柜、迁移校验）；订阅 2 道（开通 + 24 小时服务验收）。
steps.summary_en: Release 7 steps (integration tests add disk pull, rack cut, migration checksum); subscription 2 steps (provisioning + 24 h acceptance).

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 10 次构建不合格 0；24 份订阅不合格 0、最低 Cpk 155.09，服务延迟 p99 平均 18.0 ms。
steps.summary_en: 10 builds, 0 failures; 24 subscriptions, 0 failures, lowest Cpk 155.09, mean service p99 18.0 ms.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 16 / 16 项校核通过；热三副本 + 温冷 RS(6,3)：5.70 PB、≥ 12 个 9。
steps.summary_en: 16 / 16 checks pass; hot replicas + warm/cold RS(6,3): 5.70 PB, ≥ 12 nines.
